question: Why does an astrologer arise as a knower of principles for astral knowledge?
premises: Astral knowledge has a specific purpose
A knower of principles is required
The astrologer arises in relation to this need
inference: Because of the purpose of astral knowledge, the astrologer arises as a knower of its principles.
plain_english: Because of the purpose of knowledge of the luminaries, one who knows the principles becomes an astrologer.
